label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
**An open letter to friends, neighbours, school families and everyone who’s been checking in**

Hi everyone,

First of all, I’m safe. I’m staying with my sister in Rondebosch, and Marmalade is safe too.

My phone has been going mad since Saturday night, and I’m so sorry I haven’t been able to answer everyone. I’ve read so many of your messages and cried at just about all of them. People have been unbelievably kind. I’m also very tired, so I thought I’d write one proper update that anyone is welcome to forward or pass around.

There was a fire at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs at around 11:40pm on Saturday, 7 November. It started in a ground-floor flat, not mine. I live in flat 12 on the second floor.

The most important thing is that everyone in the block got out. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation at Groote Schuur and were sent home. There are 14 flats in the building, so a lot of people have had a very difficult few days.

The fire department has said it was probably an electrical fault, but they’re still investigating, and I don’t want to guess beyond that.

I woke up because our neighbour, Uncle Faizel, was banging on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. I don’t know if I’ve properly found the words to thank him yet, but I will never forget it.

I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and got out. That was it. Marmalade then hid under a car for two hours, which was not ideal for anyone’s nerves, but she’s safe now. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can’t.

My flat is basically gone. There’s smoke and water everywhere, and the lounge ceiling came down. The landlord has said nobody can move back in for at least six weeks. I’m still trying to take in what that means, but for now I have a place to stay with my sister while I work out what comes next.

I also want to say thank you. To everyone who has sent a message, offered a lift, checked on my neighbours or asked what I need: I see you, even if I haven’t managed to reply. One of the moms from school dropped a bag of clothes at my sister’s gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking. I still can’t think about that without crying. It was such a kind thing to do.

**What I need**

A few people have asked what would actually help, so here’s the honest list:

- Help towards a **deposit for a new place**.
- **School shoes in a size 6** and **work clothes in a size 34**.
- A **working laptop**, if anyone has an old one they’re no longer using. My lesson planning was on mine.

I really don’t need any more general clothes at the moment. People have already given me more than enough, and I’ll pass the extras on to the other flats. We also don’t need food right now. My sister’s freezer is full!

Please don’t feel you have to give anything. Sharing this letter, checking in on the other families in the block, or just keeping us in your thoughts means a lot.

**The fundraiser—and a warning**

My friend Zinhle has set up a BackaBuddy fundraiser to help me get back on my feet:

**backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25 000, and it had already reached R11 400 this morning. I honestly feel very weird asking for help like this. I hate it, actually. But Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, and I’m trying to listen to her. Thank you to everyone who has contributed or shared the page.

Please be careful: there is another page going around called **“Thandi Fire Relief”**, as well as a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. **Neither of those is mine or connected to Zinhle’s fundraiser.** I’ve reported them. Please don’t send money to that account, and if you see either being shared, please let the person know.

**To my Little Acorns families**

I know some of you have been worried about me, and I’m so grateful. I teach the Ladybirds, our Grade 00 class at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray, and I’ve been thinking about the children too.

Some of the things I’d taken home to laminate for the end-of-year concert are gone, including 22 crowns and the children’s handprint banner. I was heartbroken about that. But please don’t worry: **the concert on 27 November is still happening, and the Ladybirds will have crowns.** We’ll make a plan.

I’ll be back at school on Wednesday. I’d really appreciate it if we could keep things low-key in front of the children and not make a big thing of it when I arrive.

I’ll get back to comments and messages as slowly as I can, so please don’t be offended if I don’t answer your DM. I’m grateful for every one, even when I don’t have the energy to reply.

Thank you again for looking after me, Marmalade and our neighbours. It’s been a frightening few days, but the kindness has been something else.

Love,  
Thandi
